test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If in a coding system, MUSICAL is coded as 109 and RAISING is coded as 110, then how will FOURTH be coded in the same coding system?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Sum of the opposite alphabets places value - 2 = number.

MUSICAL is coded as 109

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fee7c1a327325cf954c1c45a3e08f8dd4290b3e80aa3fd4719a5a3617b8873e0.png] 

Sum of the opposite alphabets places value - 2 = number

=> (14 + 6 + 8 + 18 + 24 + 26 + 15) - 2 = 111 - 2 = 109

And,

RAISING is coded as 110

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cd9d5fe5cb48efa4d460dcbad82427509b0c110c12516f44bd89469f2e84d2b.png] 

Sum of the opposite alphabets places value - 2 = number

=> (9 + 26 + 18 + 8 + 18 + 13 + 20) - 2 = 112 - 2 = 110

Similarly,

**FOURTH** = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5eeb44f147329938d25b6310f4a973c3766cee0ef97f82510512c52c8cfa7a5b.png] 

**Sum of the opposite alphabets places value - 2 = number**

**=> (21 + 12 + 6 + 9 + 7 + 19) - 2 = 74 - 2 = 72**

Hence, the correct answer is "72".
